speaker: will_kemp
text: You have walked it, and we have walked it with you. I am not going back up that road tonight.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The bells are late. There is a rhythm in them. I will have it on the doorpost, and not in a song.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Hear that. I am tapping it. The post will hold the measure.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tap it, then. It is a rhythm, not a muster.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Look at the boy. He is supervising those men, and they do not know they are supervised.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him supervise. He is solemn, and they are not looking at him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Birch over the doors, and bread and ale set out where the houses are better. It is the parish's fire, as it always is.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have stood here twenty minutes, and twenty minutes is my measure. Alse, we are going in.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am coming. Nobody has leapt it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Nobody is leaping it. Mark me. The watch is doubled this year, and they go by in harness.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Doubled. The constables have their eyes on every knot of boys, and the boys know it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then nobody leaps. I can see the guard set on a feast from here, and the feast is the smaller of the two.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Warm, and still. There is no storm in it. The birch is green, and the tables are out, and that is the whole of the weather.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am at the door of the close. I am looking from here. I am not coming out to the street.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stay at the door, Gillis. That is where you are, and it is far enough.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have pointed the boy out. Grown men, and a child telling them the order of a fire, and not one of them has noticed the child.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The tapping is the bells, and nothing else. Leave the street its own noise.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse is coming in. I am in after her. Twenty minutes, and not a minute more.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Their bread is on their table. I am not measuring it against ours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not. Ours is at home, and it is still a penny, and it is still short of the notch.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A small fire. Faces lit from under it. I have said what the boy is doing. I am done saying it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I have the rhythm in my hand. I will not take it up anyone's stair.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I go in when the house goes in. Not before the mistress is across her own threshold.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the house goes in, and the fire stays in the street. That is the division of it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: God give you what is left of a merry night. I am for my bed, and I am not taking a riddle with me.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And I. Tomorrow is a rehearsal. The bells will still be bells in the morning.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Inside, those that belong to this door. The street has had its twenty minutes of me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am inside when you are, mistress.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go on. I have seen the fire, and I have seen that nobody leapt it. That is enough of Bishopsgate for one night.
